services.name: Facility Rental
services.desc: Host your next event, production, or brand experience at DirtFish Rally School. Located just 40 minutes from Seattle, DirtFish offers over 300 acres of private rally terrain, purpose-built gravel roads, and professional motorsport support, make it a one-of-a-kind venue for automotive, brand, and experiential events. DirtFish Rally School isn’t a blank slate, it’s an operating rally facility designed for performance driving, media production, and controlled experiences on loose surfaces.
